name: Transport critical-current surface of full-width REBCO tapes at 4.2 K (liquid helium) and 20 K (helium gas flow) in fields up to 19 T
plain_name: Map how much current superconducting tapes carry at 4 K and 20 K in very strong magnetic fields
description: Full-width commercial REBCO tapes (125 mm samples on dedicated adapters) are measured with a high-current probe in liquid helium at 4.2 K and in helium gas flow at 20 K, in magnetic fields up to 19 T, to build Ic(B,T) scaling relations for compact fusion and high-field magnets.
keywords: Map how much current superconducting tapes carry at 4 K and 20 K in very strong magnetic fields

sources.citation: Senatore, Bonura, Bagni, REBCO tapes for applications in ultra-high fields: critical current surface and scaling relations, Supercond. Sci. Technol. (2024), doi:10.1088/1361-6668/ad7f95

reported_equipment: custom setup for high-current, high-precision critical current measurements (University of Geneva)

requirements.rationale: Ic was measured at both 4.2 K and 20 K.
The Ic surface extends to 19 T.
Transport Ic measurements need current and voltage connections to the tape.
Optional: the 4.2 K data were taken in liquid helium (20 K in helium gas flow).
Optional: samples are 125 mm long on the measurement adapters.

confirmation_note: Requirements taken from the cited procedure and independently re-verified against the source (research/v4, 2026-11-01). Users must confirm them for their own run; edits require confirmation again.
